_comment: Arch-family (Arch, EndeavourOS, Manjaro, Garuda, CachyOS, BlackArch). Scanner fills in the rest.
pacman: Install, update and remove packages (Arch package manager).
yay: AUR helper — install packages from the Arch User Repository.
makepkg: Build a package from a PKGBUILD.
pacstrap: Install a base system into a mount (used during install).
